Nina Rao: quick sync 1: thinking about roll-forward guardrails for quant profile changes. we need a safe path for fp8/int8/4bit patches so customers don't see surprise quality drops.
Omar H.: +1. what's the model for "safe"? staged rollout? automatic rollback?
Nina Rao: proposal: every profile change creates a candidate fingerprint. runtime can route X% of traffic to candidate and compare outputs against baseline using a golden prompt set. if degradation metric > threshold, automatically throttle candidate and notify owner.
Priya S.: how do we compute degradation cheaply? not all customers want full eval runs. suggest two signals: embedding drift (cheap) + a tiny golden-set LM score (100 prompts). both are aggregated per-tenant and per-endpoint.
Omar H.: for per-tenant patches (e.g., enable int4 on heads 10-12), we should treat them as tenant-scoped candidates. they get same canary flow but only within tenant. also, ensure patches are immutable once applied to a resolved profile key.
Nina Rao: yes. immutability makes caching and audits easier. runtime key = sha256(base_id + sorted(patch_ids) + candidate_ts). resolved profiles are stored as artifacts with metadata.
Priya S.: ops: need an emergency escape hatch: if we detect high regression we should instantly route tenant to last known-good resolved_key and mark candidate as failed. also surface easy rollback in console.
build-bot: canary-check: golden-suite runner started at 1748888896 :gear:
Omar H.: telemetry: emit counters for candidate.assign_count, candidate.failures, candidate.latency_delta. also tag traces with "quant.candidate_id" and "quant.resolved_key".
Nina Rao: security: patches must be tenant-scoped and validated by schema (no cross-tenant references). for private/on-prem installs, disable auto-import of public profiles.
Priya S.: QA: add unit tests for delta-apply/rollback and an e2e that does tenant-scoped canary (create tenant patch -> route 5% -> assert no regression -> promote). include a negative test where we intentionally degrade to ensure rollback triggers.
Omar H.: implementation plan:
- week1: proto for patch deltas + storage artifact shape
- week2: compat parser + resolved_key generator
- week3: candidate canary wiring + golden-suite integration
- week4: console UX for promoting/rolling back candidates
Nina Rao: ok assign: Omar proto+storage, Priya telemetry+QA, Nina console UX + ownership. I'll draft a short RFC addendum and drop links here. closing thread for now.
